newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says forces kill three "foreign agents".
newsitem.headline: Iran says forces kill three "foreign agents".

text.p: Iranian security forces killed three "foreign agents" trying to infiltrate into western Iran to carry out acts of sabotage, a newspaper said on Wednesday.

The daily Kayhan quoted the top security official in Kurdistan province, which borders on Iraq, as saying the three were on a mission to bomb unspecified economic targets in the province and in other parts of the country. It did not say when they were killed.
The three had been involved in several bombings in the 1980s and one had spied for Baghdad during the 1980-88 Iran-Iraq war, the unnamed official said.
It was not clear if the slayings were related to recent Iranian reports of clashes between security forces and members of the Iraq-based Mujahideen Khalq armed opposition.
Tehran has blamed the group, which has several camps in Iraq near the Iranian border, for cross-border attacks and bombings in the past.
